paragraphs.text: Uchbenbak , also known as the Great Mistake , is a skeleton horror in the caverns of Ixalan .

Uchbenbak was introduced as a character in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan . It is a creature entirely made of bone that appears to be a mismatched collection of humanoid skeletons fused into a misshapen horror. It has numerous legs and limbs, some of which wield weapons. Its central core has a purple glow to it, where a large amount of bones are fused to form a central body.
